create_container_request: create an OpenAI container creation request by transforming name and optional params into API format
list_containers: list all OpenAI containers with pagination support using after cursor, limit, and order parameters
retrieve_container: retrieve a specific OpenAI container by its ID from the API
delete_container: delete an OpenAI container by its ID and return the deletion result
get_container_file_content: get the raw binary content of a file stored inside an OpenAI container by container and file ID
